about: BABEL's travel map (dungeon/travel.py): the tower's floors joined by the Stair, Cobb's lift cage between the Concourse and Varrow, and the broken span above the Foundry; each leg with its hours on foot, terrain and danger, each floor's encounters on the way in and at a camp off the Safe Zones (dungeon/rest.py), and its tier from the floor's beta rank. A node is a whole town (the Concourse, Hollin, the Gilded Bazaar) or a floor landing (dungeon/world/data/cities/babel-floors.json). Positions stack the floors on the map: up is up. Region cards are null: the BABEL deck (dungeon/life/decks/babel.json) draws everywhere.

routes.terrain: the road north past the Reachwall

concourse.text: A porter string coming up with salt, singing a counting song.
A party of new-wave climbers arguing about whether the exit is up or down.

varrow.text: Cobb says "Up one. Varrow. Mind how you go," the way he says it to everyone.
A Keep rider on the valley road, who looks the character over for the Mark.

varrow.action: keep clear of the Close's men checking necks at the ford
varrow.threat: Two of the Close's men want to see the character's throat, and do not ask nicely.

the-reach.text: A footprint in the frost as long as a man is tall.

the-reach.action: stay downwind of the giants crossing the moor

threat.text: A Reach giant smells the character and comes, slow and certain, across the heather.

drowned-marches.text: Lights out on the water that are not lanterns, keeping pace and then going out.

drowned-marches.action: keep to the marked causeway in the fog

threat.text: The causeway ends in black water and something under it moves.

drowned-marches.action: get past the landing toll without paying twice

threat.text: Three washed-out climbers hold the landing and want a toll in Talents, and a look in the satchel.

gilded-bazaar.text: A crier on the Copper Steps shouting the day's exchange rates for gifts and bonds.
A Lantern Room girl coming down to buy thread, who smiles at everybody.

gilded-bazaar.action: get past the landing toll without paying twice

threat.text: Three washed-out climbers hold the landing and want a toll in Talents, and a look in the satchel.

the-foundry.text: The heat comes up the Stair a full landing before the Foundry does.

the-foundry.action: get across the slag gallery before the vents breathe
the-foundry.threat: A vent breathes out across the gallery, and the air itself burns.

the-foundry.action: slip past the forge-things guarding the landing

threat.text: Something of iron and coals unfolds from the wall of the landing.

dry-hollow.text: Chalked initials and a tally on the last pillar of the broken span.

dry-hollow.action: find water on the dry floor before it finds the character first
dry-hollow.threat: The water runs out a day early on a floor without shade.

hakuro.text: Paper lanterns on the landing and a gatekeeper who bows and asks for the character's rank.

hakuro.action: keep out of a duel that is none of the character's business

threat.text: Two swordsmen on the landing decide the character will do as a witness, or as a third.

lumen-stack.text: Light pouring down the Stair from above, so bright it has a sound.

lumen-stack.action: keep the eyes covered and the feet on the stair
lumen-stack.threat: The light gets in under the eyelids and the character cannot find the next step.

st-agathes.text: A shrine on the landing with a burnt-down candle and a note in a climber's hand.

st-agathes.action: get past the shamblers on the lower landing

threat.text: The dead of St. Agathe's are on the stair, and they have heard the character.

the-catacombs.action: find the way through the bone halls without waking them

threat.text: The bones in the walls start to move as the character passes.

the-catacombs.text: A party's gear laid out neatly on a landing, and no party.

the-ashfields.action: cross the ash before the wind lifts it
the-ashfields.threat: The wind comes up and the ash with it, and the character breathes it.

threat.text: Gray shapes rise out of the drifts.

the-undercroft.action: go down without being heard by what lives at the bottom

threat.text: Something enormous turns over in the dark below, and listens.

the-undercroft.text: Old stonework down here, older than the tower's, with letters nobody reads.

concourse.text: The Concourse never quite goes quiet; somebody sings by the Stone all night.

varrow.action: keep the fire from showing to the Keep's night riders
varrow.threat: Riders from the Keep come down on the fire, asking whose the character is.

varrow.text: Bells from Saint Aurel at the night office, very far off.

the-reach.action: keep the fire small enough that the giants do not come to it

threat.text: A giant comes to the fire to warm its hands, and stays, and gets hungry.

drowned-marches.action: find a hummock dry enough to sleep on
drowned-marches.threat: The water rises in the night and everything is soaked.

drowned-marches.action: keep watch for what comes out of the reeds

threat.text: Something comes out of the reeds toward the sleepers.

gilded-bazaar.action: keep the satchel close in the Bazaar's night
gilded-bazaar.threat: Somebody light-fingered goes through the satchel in the dark.

the-foundry.action: find a landing cool enough to sleep on
the-foundry.threat: The heat keeps everyone awake, sweating, until the shakes start.

dry-hollow.action: keep the water covered from the thirsty things of the floor
dry-hollow.threat: Something drank the water in the night and left tracks around the skins.

hakuro.text: The gatekeeper brings tea at midnight and does not say why.

lumen-stack.action: find dark enough to sleep in
lumen-stack.threat: There is no dark here, and no sleep.

st-agathes.action: bar the landing against the dead

threat.text: Hands at the barricade in the small hours.

the-catacombs.action: sleep without the bones hearing it

threat.text: Rattling in the walls all night, and closer each time the fire dips.

the-ashfields.action: keep the ash out of the lungs while sleeping
the-ashfields.threat: The ash settles on the sleepers and everyone wakes coughing gray.

threat.text: The thing at the bottom has come up to look.
